## getAttestItHomeDir() function

Get the current attest-it home directory override.

Checks in order: 1. ATTEST\_IT\_HOME environment variable 2. Programmatic override via setAttestItHomeDir() 3. Returns null if using default (\~/.config/attest-it)

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function getAttestItHomeDir(): null | string;
```
**Returns:**

null \| string

The override directory, or null if using default
